title: Postman Collection to Markdown Docs

seo.title: Postman Collection to Markdown Docs — Private, Browser-Based Draft Tool | AafnaiPatro
seo.meta_description: Recursive folder-aware Markdown export focusing on request metadata and endpoint structure, excluding secrets and scripts.
seo.h1: Turn a Postman collection into a structured API handbook

requirements.runtime: browser, compiled via existing lazy route loader

input: textarea and optional file local read
limitations: Postman v3 folder-based exports are not supported. Auth tokens, response examples, scripts and request bodies are intentionally omitted.
